text:
Jordan: Quick thread — Cost Explorer UX idea: add a 'Cost confidence' badge on per-tenant / per-route cards. Right now sampling + cache-crediting noise makes the per-token number jumpy on low-traffic tenants.

Maya: I see this daily. small tenants spike 2–4x after we apply cache credits, and product teams get confused. :grimacing:

Sam: +1 for a confidence indicator. Proposal: compute a 95% CI from sampled traces and show median + uncertainty band. UI shows 'Estimated' when sample_count < threshold.

Lee: Sounds reasonable but we need to think about cost. Computing CI for every card on demand could be expensive. We should rely on pre-aggregated rollups for the common intervals.

Francesca: API idea to standardize what the UI needs: GET /internal/chargeback/estimate?start=...&end=...&route_id=...&min_samples=... returns fields: median, lower, upper, sample_count, sample_rate, cache_credits_applied. That way the UI can display: value + ±uncertainty + sample metadata.

Sam: Example request/response to be concrete:
```
# curl example (internal API)
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $INT_TOKEN" \ 
  "https://internal-api.redwood.dev/internal/chargeback/estimate?start=1719916800&end=1719993200&route_id=route-123&min_samples=50"

# response (JSON)
{
  "median_cost_per_1k_tokens": 0.013,
  "lower_95": 0.009,
  "upper_95": 0.017,
  "sample_count": 42,
  "sample_rate": "1/100",
  "cache_credits_applied": true
}
```

Lee: That payload looks fine. Implementation notes: we should compute these from daily/hourly rollups (precomputed aggregates) and only fall back to streaming aggregation for ad-hoc windows. Also include a flag that marks values that are backfilled vs live.

Jordan: UX bits: show green/yellow/red confidence swatches based on sample_count and sample_rate, tooltip with exact numbers and a link 'Why this changed' when we detect a >20% diff vs previous window. Also add a small badge if cache credits were applied (hover explains gross vs net).

Maya: Important: surface whether the number is post-cache-credit or pre-credit. Product teams keep asking which they should optimize for. Suggest a compact toggle: [Gross | Net]. Net is default.

Sam: Also recommend we surface if a recent rollout changed attribution logic (e.g., attribution-v2). Show a little notice: "Attribution logic changed on 2024-06-01 — numbers may not be comparable."

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: telemetry/v2 rolled out to prod at 1719999123 :white_check_mark:

Lee: After telemetry/v2 deploy, we'll need a short migration to backfill sample_rate and sample_count for historical windows so the UI can show consistent confidence bars for past dates. That backfill can be batched offline.

Francesca: I'll open a PR for the internal endpoint and a short design doc for the rollups/backfill tonight. Will include query cost estimates and a suggested TTL for pre-aggregates.

Jordan: Action items: Francesca -> PR for endpoint + design doc; Lee -> migration/backfill plan + cost estimate; Maya -> mockups for the confidence badge + gross/net toggle; Sam -> wire UI to call endpoint behind feature flag. Please reply with +1 if you can take.

Maya: I'll take the mockup. 👍

Sam: I'll wire the UI and add feature flag. +1

Francesca: PR incoming, will tag you all.

Lee: I'll draft backfill plan by EOD tomorrow.

Jordan: Great — thanks all. Will loop back after PR and mockups.
